criteria.criterion: Plans replay deterministically with pinned guidance/inputs and never count as executed proofs.
criteria.explanation: Eight constructed admitted goals were planned under a shared eight-source pool and a closed LogicTactician replica (no network, write, or proof execution). Unguided and pinned-ranker arms each replayed three times with seeds 104729/130363/155921; plan_id is identical across replays of the same (goal, arm). The pinned ranker digest sha256:412ce3d4786228d7ac06bbb1be509dc94743d1aae029b5a9f841a783f17f3406 is a disclosed hand-authored reverse-reorder of admitted sources, not a model call; every guided plan identity differs from the matching unguided plan. All 72 observation rows set counts_as_executed_proof false, result_kind bounded_observation or no_run, semantic_authority false, and proof_execution_allowed false. LLM nomination is recorded as unavailable with zero model calls.

criteria.criterion: Candidate and accepted-proof rates, native coverage, failure categories and all-attempt costs are reported separately.
criteria.explanation: The proof-assistance summary reports candidate_rate, accepted_proof_rate, native_coverage, failure_categories, and all_attempt_costs as distinct objects. Hammer and Leanstral candidate rates are 0.0/5 because no solver or model produced a candidate; accepted-proof rates and native coverage are 0.0/5 with native_checked_proofs=0. Failure categories are counted separately: unsupported_translation 6, unavailable_solver 3, unavailable_native_checker 5, unavailable_model_service 15, policy_rejected_sorry 2, policy_rejected_admit 2, policy_rejected_unapproved_axiom 2. Planning reports its own all-attempt costs (72 attempts) separately from assistance costs (47 attempts including sealed-PATH probes). TPTP/SMT encodings (Hammer encoding_rate 0.6) are not counted as solver candidates.

Policy fixtures are labeled not_a_model_output.
